archive.title: Archive
archive.desc: Workspace for completed events — statistics, media ZIP, gallery and participant records. Only numbers appear on public surfaces.
archive.emptyDesc: Events with POST_EVENT, RECONCILIATION or ARCHIVED status are listed here. You can change their status from the Events screen.
archive.kvkkBodyA: Archive participant names and contact details are kept only in this workspace (tenant-internal); on the company showcase and other public surfaces only the participant
archive.kvkkBodyB: is shown. Personal data is managed separately from campaign segments in the Communication module for deletion/anonymization requests. (KVKK art. 5/6 — data minimization)
archive.segmentCreatedDesc: Mailing draft ready for "{name}" in the Communication module.
archive.galleryDesc: Images uploaded to this edition in the Media Archive (max 24 items — loaded lazily).
archive.peopleDesc: Tenant-internal view: names stay in this workspace only. Only {count} are shown in the public showcase.
archive.noMediaDesc: Upload files to this edition from the Media Archive module.
